articles.title: Huntington Bancshares and Cadence Bank Shareholders Approve Pending Merger
articles.mainIdea: Huntington Bancshares and Cadence Bank Shareholders Approve Pending Merger
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Huntington Bancshares and Cadence Bank Shareholders Approve Pending Merger. Huntington Bancshares Incorporated (Nasdaq: HBAN); ("Huntington") and Cadence Bank (NYSE: CADE); ("Cadence") jointly announced that Cadence's shareholders have approved the proposed merger of Cadence into The Huntington National Bank and that Huntington's shareholders have approved the issuance of shares of Huntington's common stock in connection with the proposed merger at their respective special shareholder meetings held today. Related tickers mentioned: CADE, CADE-PA, HBANL, HBANM, HBANP.
